title: Pivotal coordinates and selected width
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and let $\varphi$ be a disjunctive normal form on $\{-1,1\}^n$: each term is a conjunction of literals on distinct coordinates, and the formula is the disjunction of its terms. At any input $x$, choose a term satisfied by $x$ if the formula outputs $-1$, and otherwise use the empty term; the number of coordinates whose flip changes the formula's output, when its output at $x$ is $-1$, is at most the number of literals in that chosen term.
hypotheses_covered: $\varphi$ is a DNF formula on the Boolean cube
$x$ is an input in the Boolean cube
